description: LandWatch land, ranch, farm and hunting property listings for a US state (optionally one county): title, price, acres, price per acre, recent price change, property types, beds/baths/home size when there is a house, address, city, county, ZIP, coordinates, broker name, company and phone, last update and link; 25 per page (page 1 to 40), plus the total count. From landwatch.com's public search pages via a residential proxy. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

county.description: Optional county name, e.g. 'edwards county' or 'travis'

state.description: US state name, e.g. texas or 'north carolina'
